name: HANA Micron Inc.
summary: Hana Micron, Inc. specializes in delivering semiconductor packaging solutions and comprehensive testing services. Their diverse offerings encompass flip chip ball grid array, flexible and wafer-level chip scale packaging, fine pitch ball grid array, and lead frame base products, as well as analog and logic testing, among other specialized services. This company was established on August 23, 2001, with its primary operations based in Asan-si, South Korea.
